articleTitle: Opto-electronic oscillator and its applications
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP '96 Technical Digest. Satellite Workshop (Cat. No.96TH8153)
abstract: We present the theoretical and experimental results of a new class of microwave oscillators called optoelectronic oscillators (OEO). We discuss techniques of achieving high stability single mode operation and demonstrate the applications of OEO in photonic communication systems.

articleTitle: Novel technique for generation of optical SSB with carrier using a single MZM to overcome fiber chromatic dispersion
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP '96 Technical Digest. Satellite Workshop (Cat. No.96TH8153)
abstract: We demonstrate a novel and simple technique for the generation of optical SSB with carrier using a single Mach-Zehnder modulator to overcome dispersion effects in fibre-wireless systems. A dispersion penalty <0.5 dB for BER of 10/sup -9/ was measured for 51.8 Mb/s BPSK data transmission at 12 GHz over 80 km of fibre.

articleTitle: Microwave generation and transmission using optical heterodyning or optical upconversion technique
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP '96 Technical Digest. Satellite Workshop (Cat. No.96TH8153)
abstract: Two optical/microwave generation techniques are discussed. 140 Mbit/s transmissions with optically generated microwaves at frequencies at of 18 and 60-70 GHz are reported. Quartz accuracy and sub-Hertz linewidths of an optical microwave generator signal are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Spatial optical processing array antenna for multibeam reception
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP '96 Technical Digest. Satellite Workshop (Cat. No.96TH8153)
abstract: We propose a multibeam receiving antenna using spatial optical processing technique in a beam forming network. Also we experimentally investigate the basic performance of optical-microwave conversion, a key technology for achieving this antenna.

articleTitle: Optical access links suppressing optical beat interference with FP-LDs for microwave transmission
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP '96 Technical Digest. Satellite Workshop (Cat. No.96TH8153)
abstract: Uncooled Fabry-Perot laser diodes (FP-LDs) without isolators realize cost-effective optical access links for microwave transmission. The optical spectrum broadening using low-frequency intensity-modulation can effectively suppress optical beat interference in the up link and make FP-LD performance stable.

articleTitle: Generation of CW THz radiation by optical heterodyne with diode lasers and LTG-GaAs photoconductors
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP '96 Technical Digest. Satellite Workshop (Cat. No.96TH8153)
abstract: The absolute power and the spectral profile of the CW THz radiation generated by optical heterodyne with diode lasers and LTG-GaAs photoconductors is discussed. An output radiation of l-nW order and a linewidth of 30 MHz were obtained. These values can be easily improved by employing current techniques for stabilizing diode lasers and by the fabrication of high-photoconductivity devices.

articleTitle: Design and performance of an optically controlled phased array antenna
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP '96 Technical Digest. Satellite Workshop (Cat. No.96TH8153)
abstract: An optical beamformer incorporating a 360/spl deg/ phase SLM was remotely coupled to a nine-element antenna through 100 metre of ribbon fibre. In our antenna test facility it provided stable and close-to-theoretical performance at 1.3 GHz.

articleTitle: Phase coherency of generated millimeter wave signals using fiber optic distribution of a reference
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP '96 Technical Digest. Satellite Workshop (Cat. No.96TH8153)
abstract: The work presented here is focused on analytical comparison of various methods of generating a low phase noise millimeter-wave local signal, from a frequency reference. Noise performance requirements of directly and externally modulated fiber optic distribution networks are considered. Four techniques of multiplication, phase-locked loop, injection locking, and injection locking with phase locked loop are compared in terms of system figures of merit.

articleTitle: Microwave optical filters based on a fibre Bragg grating in a loop structure
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP '96 Technical Digest. Satellite Workshop (Cat. No.96TH8153)
abstract: A new optical transversal filter structure that features a large number of taps using a single Bragg grating in an active loop is presented. The topology has been used to realise high Q microwave bandpass filters. The impulse response has demonstrated well in excess of 50 taps with precise characteristics. The frequency response demonstrates high resolution having a narrowband bandpass response with a Q of 200. This structure also has the capability for tunable operation.

articleTitle: A simple microwave oscillator photodetector operating with optical signals designed by an illuminated FET model
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP '96 Technical Digest. Satellite Workshop (Cat. No.96TH8153)
abstract: This paper describes modeling for an illuminated self-aligned GaAs MESFET with nonlinear parameters and experimental evaluation of an FET oscillator with non-modulated, CW and pulse signal illumination for optical control, injection locking and digital signal communication.

articleTitle: 60 GHz millimeter-wave generation and transport over OFDM fiber-optic networks
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP '96 Technical Digest. Satellite Workshop (Cat. No.96TH8153)
abstract: Optical generation of many MM-wave signals using a coherent multi-frequency light source and its transport over optical frequency-division multiplexing fiber-optic network is proposed. The experimental results of 61 GHz MM-wave generation and 40 km-long transport is demonstrated.

articleTitle: A wide-band electro-optical E-field probe powered by a solar cell
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP '96 Technical Digest. Satellite Workshop (Cat. No.96TH8153)
abstract: A wide-band electro-optical E-field probe based on a short dipole antenna directly modulating a MQW/RWG laser, which is biased utilising a 2V solar cell, has been developed and characterised in the frequency range 0.5 to 18 GHz. A minimum detectable field strength better than 10 mV/m was achieved from 0.5 to 12 GHz for an S/N of 10 dB using a 10 Hz measurement bandwidth. Dynamic range and antenna patterns are also reported.

articleTitle: Millimeter-wave (37 GHz) transmission of data (up to 500 Mb/s) in an optically fed wireless link incorporating a hybrid mode-locked monolithic DBR laser
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP '96 Technical Digest. Satellite Workshop (Cat. No.96TH8153)
abstract: We demonstrate for the first time, low error rate transmission of 200 Mb/s BPSK data at 37 GHz using a hybrid mode-locked monolithic DBR laser. In addition we demonstrate low error-rate data transmission up to 500 Mb/s over an optically fed wireless link at 37 GHz which is suitable for picocellular communications and indoor wireless networks.

articleTitle: Optical intensity modulator using inverted slot line at 60 GHz
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP '96 Technical Digest. Satellite Workshop (Cat. No.96TH8153)
abstract: The inverted slot line (ISL) structure which has been proposed for millimeter wave LiNbO/sub 3/ optical modulator is found to be very simple in structure, and also is capable of achieving perfect velocity matching between carrier and modulating waves. This paper describes the development of a Mach-Zehnder Ti-diffused LiNbO/sub 3/ optical intensity modulator using the ISL at 60 GHz. To launch millimeter waves into the ISL structure two types of transitions have been developed successfully. In one type, a balun which is made from semirigid coaxial cable is used to feed millimeter waves into the ISL. In another type, nonradiative dielectric (NRD) waveguide, which can provide the total integration of the modulator with millimeter wave integrated circuits, is used to excite the ISL structure ensuring minimum transition losses. Optical response of 0.17 W/sup -1/ could be obtained at 60 GHz using a Mach-Zehnder interferometer with a rather poor extinction ratio of 5 dB at an optical wavelength of 0.633 /spl mu/m.

articleTitle: Some limits on the performance of an analog optical link
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP '96 Technical Digest. Satellite Workshop (Cat. No.96TH8153)
abstract: Recent performance improvements in analog optical links have prompted us to analytically investigate the limits to link performance. In this paper these limits are derived and compared to current state-of-the-art link performance.

articleTitle: Optical devices for millimetre-wave transmission
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP '96 Technical Digest. Satellite Workshop (Cat. No.96TH8153)
abstract: The development of practical and high-performance optoelectronic device technology at BT Laboratories (BTL) for millimetre-wave analogue optical links is described. Two-moded lasers (for the transmitter) and heterojunction bipolar phototransistors (for the receiver) are discussed in detail.

articleTitle: A self-oscillating optoelectronic up-converter using a heterojunction bipolar transistor up to millimeter-wave bands
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP '96 Technical Digest. Satellite Workshop (Cat. No.96TH8153)
abstract: Fiber optic subcarrier transmission links for personal mobile communications have been investigated. These links, which integrate optical fiber communications technology and wireless communications technology, are important for distributing signals in mobile communications environments. This paper presents an experimental study on a self-oscillating optoelectronic up-converter (SOOEUP) using a single heterojunction bipolar transistor chip. The characteristics of a balanced SOOEUP are also described.

articleTitle: Photonic mixing using a Franz-Keldysh electroabsorption modulator monolithically integrated with a DFB laser
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP '96 Technical Digest. Satellite Workshop (Cat. No.96TH8153)
abstract: The photonic mixing properties of a Franz-Keldysh (FK) electroabsorption modulator monolithically integrated with a DFB laser has been characterised. By using a HEMT based impedance matching network between the detector diode and the 50 /spl Omega/ output line a conversion gain of 30 dB has been obtained for downconversion from 3 to 0.1 GHz.

articleTitle: Multichannel coherent SCM optical transmission system using radio-to-optic direct conversion scheme
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP '96 Technical Digest. Satellite Workshop (Cat. No.96TH8153)
abstract: This paper newly proposes SCM coherent optical transmission system using a radio-to-optic direct conversion scheme, where the SCM RF signal can be converted into an optical frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) signals with the same frequency interval as SCM radio signal with the same signaling and multiplexing format. The theoretical received CNR analysis shows and as a result, it is clarified that the received CNR of the proposed system is better than that of the conventional coherent and IM/DD system.

articleTitle: An optical microwave source for frequency synthesiser applications
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP '96 Technical Digest. Satellite Workshop (Cat. No.96TH8153)
abstract: The difference frequency of two lasers is stabilised by an optical discriminator to produce a stepped microwave frequency source with phase noise levels of -90 dBc/Hz at 1 kHz offset, with potential for operation up to 100 GHz.

articleTitle: Maximal ratio combining macro diversity for micro-cellular slotted ALOHA
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP '96 Technical Digest. Satellite Workshop (Cat. No.96TH8153)
abstract: This paper proposes a new slotted-ALOHA packet radio system with macro-diversity reception for microcellular mobile communication systems. The proposed system uses a modified maximal ratio combining strategy, which chooses the N strongest packet signals and adds them with maximal ratio combining.

articleTitle: Radiowave signal detection system using electrooptic modulator
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP '96 Technical Digest. Satellite Workshop (Cat. No.96TH8153)
abstract: A radiowave detection system for TV relay stations has been developed using an optical waveguide modulator with a passive resonant circuit. Carrier to noise ratio of above 50 dB is obtained at an electric field of 60 dBuV/m.

articleTitle: Two-dimensional multiple beam forming using slab-waveguide-implemented photonic beam forming network
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP '96 Technical Digest. Satellite Workshop (Cat. No.96TH8153)
abstract: A slab-waveguide-implemented photonic beam forming network (BFN) applicable to two-dimensional multiple beam forming is proposed. The design point is the use of grating lobes. A slab waveguide design is presented that achieves flexible beam arrangement from variously arranged planar arrays. As an example, a two-dimensional 9 beam formation is demonstrated using a slab waveguide fabricated on a SiO/sub 2/-Si substrate.

articleTitle: Generation of frequency/phase-modulated millimeter-wave subcarrier signals with a subharmonically hybrid mode-locked monolithic semiconductor laser
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP '96 Technical Digest. Satellite Workshop (Cat. No.96TH8153)
abstract: Novel methods are proposed and demonstrated for the generation of angle-modulated millimeter-wave optical signals; use of a monolithic semiconductor laser under subharmonic hybrid mode-locking conditions provides a compact and efficient scheme for frequency and phase modulation of subcarriers.

articleTitle: Optimization of millimeter-wave signal generation using multi-electrode semiconductor lasers with subharmonic electrical injection
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP '96 Technical Digest. Satellite Workshop (Cat. No.96TH8153)
abstract: We present a detailed investigation of the nonlinear behaviour of a multi-electrode semiconductor laser with millimeter-wave repetition frequency (39 GHz) under subharmonic electrical injection. Our results indicate that small subharmonic numbers (n=2-4) should be used to achieve both reasonable modulation depth and phase noise of the 39 GHz signal.

articleTitle: The past, present and future of microwave photonics
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP '96 Technical Digest. Satellite Workshop (Cat. No.96TH8153)
abstract: The rapid development of microwave and optical electronics over the past few decades led to the natural merger of these important technologies, and microwave photonics was born. This paper highlights some of the past developments and attempts to identify future trends in microwave photonics.

articleTitle: Optical beam scanning of active patch antennas
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP '96 Technical Digest. Satellite Workshop (Cat. No.96TH8153)
abstract: It is experimentally shown that the radiation pattern from two coupled active antennas can be changed by laser illumination of the FET. The null direction is scanned 22 degrees by the laser power of up to 19 mW.

articleTitle: Subcarrier optical transmission techniques for wireless local loop (WLL)
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP '96 Technical Digest. Satellite Workshop (Cat. No.96TH8153)
abstract: The WLL system has some advantages in that the access equipment is economical and the installation is easier and faster. A cell station (WCS) for the WLL is generally constructed of two components, one is made up of the radio transmitter and receiver, and the other is made up of the modulator/demodulator (MODEM) and other devices. Subcarrier optical transmission techniques can reduce the size of WCS and decrease power consumption, since the MODEM equipment is set up at a telephone center. However, laser diodes (LDs) utilized for an electric-to-optic (E/O) conversion are very expensive, because of the demand for linearity and low noise characteristics. In this paper, the application of signal extraction and frequency arrangement (SEFA) technique along with a new idea, i.e. a level compression technique among input signals (LCS), are discussed. As a result, it is clarified that an economical Fabry-Perot LD (FP-LD) can be applied to the subcarrier optical transmission techniques, even though their linearity and noise characteristics are worse than those of the distributed feedback LD (DFB-LD).

articleTitle: Inter-satellite link by lightwave
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP '96 Technical Digest. Satellite Workshop (Cat. No.96TH8153)
abstract: Technological basis and requirement for inter-satellite optical communication links are described in connection with recent advancement in optical devices and components. The space demonstration programs in the world are reviewed, including the major results of the first ground-to-satellite laser communications experiment recently performed by the Communications Research Laboratory.

articleTitle: Phase stabilization of reference signals in analog fiber-optic links
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP '96 Technical Digest. Satellite Workshop (Cat. No.96TH8153)
abstract: A feedback technique that utilizes a special optical modulator is used to reduce the phase noise of RF signals in microwave fiber-optic links. Experimental results indicate a reduction in the phase noise of a 150 MHz signal by more than 14 dB at offset frequencies of up to 4 kHz from carrier.

articleTitle: Design of patch antennas for integration in OEICs for optical fiber picocellular systems
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP '96 Technical Digest. Satellite Workshop (Cat. No.96TH8153)
abstract: We investigate theoretically several patch antenna structures for integration in OEICs incorporating photonic devices and MM-wave amplifiers. We show that to obtain optimum antenna performance, separate dielectric layers must be used to isolate the antenna from the feeding structure which incorporates the OEIC.

articleTitle: Generation of a 152 GHz pulse train from a hybrid modelocked monolithic semiconductor DBR laser
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP '96 Technical Digest. Satellite Workshop (Cat. No.96TH8153)
abstract: A 152 GHz dual frequency beat signal is generated from a 38 GHz hybrid modelocked monolithic DBR laser and transformed into a train of 1.8 ps pulses by adiabatic compression in a dispersion decreasing fibre.

articleTitle: Optically controlled microwave devices
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP '96 Technical Digest. Satellite Workshop (Cat. No.96TH8153)
abstract: In this paper, a review is given of recent advances in optically controlled microwave and millimeter wave devices and circuits. Special emphasis will firstly be laid on the physical background of optical effects in semiconductor materials and structures. In a second step, different microwave optical interaction phenomena are summarized and an overview of recent results on optically controlled devices is presented. Furthermore, distributed and traveling-wave components such as phase and amplitude modulators are studied and discussed in detail, where aspects of monolithic integration are also addressed. Finally, future trends in microwave or optical applications of corresponding photonic devices are elucidated.

articleTitle: Ultrafast E-O sampling using ZnTe crystal and Ti:sapphire laser
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP '96 Technical Digest. Satellite Workshop (Cat. No.96TH8153)
abstract: Ultrafast sub-ps resolution electro-optic (E-O) sampling system using ZnTe crystal and Ti:sapphire laser is described. 3.5 ps response of an ultrafast photodiode has been measured using the system. Differential detection and optical pulse reshaping by a grating pair are discussed for advanced design.

articleTitle: Fabry-Perot laser high linearity analog optical links
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP '96 Technical Digest. Satellite Workshop (Cat. No.96TH8153)
abstract: High dynamic range analog optical links are demonstrated using a variety of Fabry-Perot lasers, including commercial and custom devices. All of the devices demonstrate a dynamic range and noise figure close to that of an analog DFB laser for short (<2 km) links. The best devices have performance which rivals that of a typical DFB laser.

articleTitle: Proposal of radio highway network using a novel direct optical switched CDMA method
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP '96 Technical Digest. Satellite Workshop (Cat. No.96TH8153)
abstract: In this proposed network, bipolar codes such as maximal length codes and Gold codes can be applied by using a correlator consisting of a polarity-reversing-divider and a balanced mixing photodetector (BMPD).

articleTitle: EMC measurements using electrooptic waveguide modulators
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP '96 Technical Digest. Satellite Workshop (Cat. No.96TH8153)
abstract: This paper presents results on broadband electroabsorption travelling-wave modulators, designed for employment in a fibre optic field sensor, capable of measuring electric and magnetic fields even within biological tissue.

articleTitle: High-speed photodetectors with high saturation for high performance microwave photonic systems
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP '96 Technical Digest. Satellite Workshop (Cat. No.96TH8153)
abstract: We proposed a velocity-matched distributed photodetector (VMDP) to achieve high saturation power and large bandwidth. The VMDP with 56 mA saturation photocurrent and an instrument-limited 3-dB bandwidth of 49 GHz is demonstrated.

articleTitle: High speed photonic devices for millimeter wave systems
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP '96 Technical Digest. Satellite Workshop (Cat. No.96TH8153)
abstract: In this paper, we describe and compare the performance of mm-wave optical transmitters based on resonant modulation of monolithic semiconductor lasers, feedforward modulation, and a passively mode-locked laser operating in an optoelectronic phase-locked loop.

articleTitle: Wireless access in HFC systems
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP '96 Technical Digest. Satellite Workshop (Cat. No.96TH8153)
abstract: Wireless access in HFC (hybrid-fiber-coax) systems essentially integrates two major telecommunication infrastructure, i.e., wireless and HFC networks. From a transmission system technology point of view, this paper reviews the feasibility and technical limitations in carrying out the network integration. Capacity estimation of an HFC optical node-based CDMA and TDMA microcellular/PCS systems using an upstream channel model is provided. The channel model consists of an empirical wave propagation model for transmission from handset to the radio antenna port (RAP), a coaxial cable model that takes into account ingress noise and microreflections, and a clipping-limited laser diode.

articleTitle: High capacity hybrid fibre-radio field experiments at 60 GHz
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP '96 Technical Digest. Satellite Workshop (Cat. No.96TH8153)
abstract: The results of unidirectional and interactive operating field experiments of hybrid fibre radio transmission systems at 60 GHz are presented. High capacity data signals up to 140 Mbit/s are transported over a terrestrial installed link of 46.2 km standard singlemode fibre and are optically distributed to miniaturised remote antenna units which are serving pico-radio-cells. Furthermore, the impact of polarisation mode dispersion on system performance has been experimentally investigated.

articleTitle: High repetition rate, ultrashort pulse generation using mode-locked semiconductor lasers
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP '96 Technical Digest. Satellite Workshop (Cat. No.96TH8153)
abstract: A train of transform-limited optical pulses with duration of 2.3 ps is generated from monolithically fabricated mode-locked semiconductor lasers at the high repetition rate of 33 GHz. Higher repetition rates over 1 THz are observed by harmonic passive mode-locking. Furthermore, the timing jitter of the pulse trains is reduced with the injection of electrical or optical signal to mode-locked lasers.

articleTitle: Design and modeling of microwave photonic devices
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP '96 Technical Digest. Satellite Workshop (Cat. No.96TH8153)
abstract: Computer-aided design tools based on various finite element and beam propagation methods which are indispensable to modeling of microwave photonic devices are briefly reviewed. Some of them are utilized to simulate a traveling-wave Ti:LiNbO/sub 3/ optical modulator with a ridge structure.

articleTitle: High-speed electroabsorption modulator integrated with DFB laser with bandwidth over 30 GHz and its pulse generation
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP '96 Technical Digest. Satellite Workshop (Cat. No.96TH8153)
abstract: An integrated electroabsorption modulator integrated with a DFB laser exhibits very high speed modulation characteristics with a bandwidth over 30 GHz. It generates clear and stable optical pulse trains at repetition rates as high as 30 GHz-40 GHz for the first time.

articleTitle: 60 GHz radiation detection using electro-optic effect of DAST crystal
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP '96 Technical Digest. Satellite Workshop (Cat. No.96TH8153)
abstract: Coherent detection using electro-optic effect is an attractive method for high frequency electric field measurement. Organic crystals have the advantages of a large electro-optic coefficient and a small dielectric constant for the high speed detection. We demonstrate for the first time the coherent detection of freely propagating 60 GHz millimeter wave by using organic DAST crystal.

articleTitle: Antenna-coupled millimeter-wave electro-optic modulators for 20 to 100 GHz
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP '96 Technical Digest. Satellite Workshop (Cat. No.96TH8153)
abstract: Coupling the signal to the electrodes of an integrated electro-optical modulator with an array of antennas is used to velocity-match the modulation and optical waves, greatly extending-the length-to-modulation frequency product of the modulator. In addition, antenna coupling eliminates the parasitic elements associated with coax connectors, matching transformers and bond wires. This paper summarizes the results obtained to date with this technique at 20 to 100 GHz, with phase modulators, Mach-Zehnder modulators, and delta-beta directional coupler modulators.

articleTitle: Proposal of Radio Highway Networks using chirp multiplexing transform
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP '96 Technical Digest. Satellite Workshop (Cat. No.96TH8153)
abstract: This paper proposes a Radio Highway Network using chirp multiplexing transform, where multicarrier radio multi-services are converted into a TDM signal format, and are asynchronously fed into a optical bus link. Cell loss probability and received CNR are theoretically analyzed.

articleTitle: Advanced techniques for the optical generation of microwave signals
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP '96 Technical Digest. Satellite Workshop (Cat. No.96TH8153)
abstract: The paper describes recent developments in the generation of microwave modulated optical signals using optical phase lock loops, including quantum confined Stark effect tuned VCO lasers and the first heterodyne optical injection phase lock loops.

articleTitle: Linearized modulators for analog photonic links
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP '96 Technical Digest. Satellite Workshop (Cat. No.96TH8153)
abstract: The potential applications of high dynamic range analog RF photonic links include antenna remoting, photonic-coupled phased-array antennas, and cable-television transmission. This paper compares the results obtained with a number of different electro-optic modulator types and link configurations assuming an ideal velocity-matched modulator. The degrading effects of velocity mismatching are also presented for some of the modulators studied.

articleTitle: Signal extraction with frequency arrangement (SEFA) schemes in fiber-oriented wireless access systems
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP '96 Technical Digest. Satellite Workshop (Cat. No.96TH8153)
abstract: Noise and non-linearity characteristics are very important factors for wireless access systems using subcarrier optical transmission. The signal extraction with frequency arrangement (SEFA) is proposed for improving carrier-to-noise ratio (CNR) because the 3rd-order intermodulation distortion (IM3) produced by E/O can be ignored. Simulation results show that SEFA greatly improves the transmission performance. This technology will make possible cheaper E/O device implementation into a fiber-oriented wireless access systems.

articleTitle: Millimetre-wave superlattice oscillators for optically-fed wireless communications
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP '96 Technical Digest. Satellite Workshop (Cat. No.96TH8153)
abstract: We report on millimetre-wave superlattice oscillators intended for use in optically-fed wireless communication systems as injection locked light to mm-wave converters. mm-wave generation is demonstrated in the Q and V bands, as well as high bit rate data transmission.

articleTitle: Ultrafast modulation of resonant light and transient wave mixing in semiconductor quantum wells
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP '96 Technical Digest. Satellite Workshop (Cat. No.96TH8153)
abstract: A density matrix approach is employed to investigate a high speed all-optical modulation process in semiconductor quantum wells. The effect of nonlinear wave-mixing on the modulation process due to asymmetricity of the system is also discussed.

articleTitle: Millimeter-wave region optical devices
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP '96 Technical Digest. Satellite Workshop (Cat. No.96TH8153)
abstract: This paper describes ultra-high-speed optical-device structures and characteristics of Mach-Zehnder waveguide LiNbO/sub 3/ modulators, electroabsorption MQW semiconductor modulators, and edge-coupled photodetectors.

articleTitle: Optically controlled phased array radar
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP '96 Technical Digest. Satellite Workshop (Cat. No.96TH8153)
abstract: The experimental results presented in this paper indicate that optically driven phased array antennas with high performance and true time delay can be practically implemented. The paper concentrates on the potential performance of optically driven antenna systems using a coherent WDM architecture.

articleTitle: Subband-resonance oscillations in photoexcited GaAs-AlAs type-II superlattices
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP '96 Technical Digest. Satellite Workshop (Cat. No.96TH8153)
abstract: Subband-resonance oscillations have been observed in photoexcited, undoped type-II GaAsAlAs superlattices. The frequency can be tuned over a wide range either by the applied voltage or the photoexcited carrier density. The oscillations are due to an oscillating domain boundary between two electric-field domains.

articleTitle: Terahertz radiation excited by ultrafast supercurrent modulation [of YBCO thin films]
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP '96 Technical Digest. Satellite Workshop (Cat. No.96TH8153)
abstract: We realized a new type of terahertz radiation by an ultrafast supercurrent modulation in high-T/sub c/ superconductors with femtosecond laser pulse irradiation. Sub-/spl mu/W radiation into free space with a pulse width of 0.4 ps was detected.

articleTitle: Ultrafast photoconductive detectors based on semiconductors with long carrier lifetimes
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP '96 Technical Digest. Satellite Workshop (Cat. No.96TH8153)
abstract: Photoconductive switches based on semiconductors with long carrier lifetimes were fabricated and used to detect terahertz (THz) radiation pulses. The detector responses were compared with those of a photoconductive detector based on a semiconductor with a very short carrier lifetime.

articleTitle: Optically-controlled serially-fed phased array transmitter
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP '96 Technical Digest. Satellite Workshop (Cat. No.96TH8153)
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a new optically controlled phased array system which has all the advantages of true time delay yet only requires one tunable laser, one optical modulator and one fiber optic grating unit.

articleTitle: Highly-stabilized, tunable millimeter-wave generation by using fiber-optic frequency comb generator
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP '96 Technical Digest. Satellite Workshop (Cat. No.96TH8153)
abstract: Highly-stabilized 60 GHz-band mm-wave signal generation over 108 km-long optical fiber link at /spl lambda/=1560 nm is demonstrated by using a fiber-optic frequency comb generator having discrete emission spectrum as the light source.

articleTitle: Optically controlled microwave magnetostatic wave transmission line
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP '96 Technical Digest. Satellite Workshop (Cat. No.96TH8153)
abstract: Modulation of microwave signal frequency, phase and delay time in a magnetostatic spin wave transmission line containing a thin yttrium-iron-garnet film under illumination with short optical pulses has been observed and investigated.

articleTitle: Generation of 3.6 ps optical pulses with repetition rate of 20 GHz using a high efficient electroabsorption modulator
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP '96 Technical Digest. Satellite Workshop (Cat. No.96TH8153)
abstract: This paper reports on stable generation of optical short pulses using an InGaAsP/InGaAsP strained multiple quantum well (MQW) electro-absorption (EA) modulator. Nearly transform-limited pulse trains with a narrowest pulse width of 3.6 ps are demonstrated by applying a 20 GHz sinusoidal voltage to the EA modulator. The MQW absorption layers in the EA modulator consist of tensile-strained wells and compressive-strained barriers, resulting in a large extinction efficiency of 20 dB/V, a small polarization sensitivity of 0.3 dB, and a high modulation bandwidth of 15 GHz.

articleTitle: Instantaneous image observation of ultrafast electrical pulse propagating on metal strip
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP '96 Technical Digest. Satellite Workshop (Cat. No.96TH8153)
abstract: Instantaneous potential distribution of 2 ps propagating pulse was visualized using a scanning force optoelectronic microscope. A special probe made of low temperature grown GaAs is the key in the optical sampling measurement.

articleTitle: High current modulation in optically controlled MOSFET using directly-bonded SiO/sub 2/-InP
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP '96 Technical Digest. Satellite Workshop (Cat. No.96TH8153)
abstract: High current modulation in an optically controlled MOSFET has been obtained. The structure of the device was composed of the absorption region of pin photo diode and the MOSFET region bonded by using SiO/sub 2/-InP direct wafer bonding technique. When the laser light with a wavelength of 1.50 /spl mu/m was irradiated to the absorption region, more than 550 /spl mu/A of drain-to-source current modulation and a maximum responsivity of more than 280 A/W was obtained.

articleTitle: Observation of SAW solitons with an optical sampling probe
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP '96 Technical Digest. Satellite Workshop (Cat. No.96TH8153)
abstract: A novel optical probe for surface acoustic wave waveform measurements has been constructed. Resolution 1.3 /spl mu/m and bandwidth 1 GHz allowed to observe for the first time a breakdown of high power SAW into solitons.

articleTitle: Synthesis of microwave frequency window responses using all-optical Mach-Zehnder lattices
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP '96 Technical Digest. Satellite Workshop (Cat. No.96TH8153)
abstract: This paper presents a new algorithm for the synthesis of microwave frequency finite impulse response filters, using a passive all-optical fibre Mach-Zehnder lattice structure.

articleTitle: Study of optical beat interference in the injection locking of regenerative gain switching oscillator [using diode lasers]
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP '96 Technical Digest. Satellite Workshop (Cat. No.96TH8153)
abstract: The properties of the regenerative gain switching type injection locked oscillator (ILO) as a clock recovering circuit are investigated. It is found that such a device is not affected by injected optical beat noise, and is capable in multiple optical carrier networks.

articleTitle: A novel optical control technique using tunable inductance circuits
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP '96 Technical Digest. Satellite Workshop (Cat. No.96TH8153)
abstract: A novel optical inductance control technique using tunable inductance circuits is presented. The technique employs direct illumination as a means of optically controlling inductance. This is a promising technique for controlling oscillators, filters, active antennas, etc.

articleTitle: A novel circuit diagnostic technique using electro-optic sampling
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP '96 Technical Digest. Satellite Workshop (Cat. No.96TH8153)
abstract: We have developed a novel probing system for internal node diagnostics. This probe uses an electro-optic sampling technique. It has sub-/spl mu/m spatial resolution, a few mV voltage resolution and 100 ps temporal resolution. The prototype system has a measurement bandwidth of 3 GHz.

articleTitle: Determination of semiconductor properties through Hall-effect measurement with contactless microwave techniques
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP '96 Technical Digest. Satellite Workshop (Cat. No.96TH8153)
abstract: The scattering characteristics of semiconductors with tensor conductivity resulting from the Hall-effect are analyzed with 3-D edge-element to determine the properties of the semiconductor. Some useful curves are given and the procedure of determining the mobility and the carrier concentration of II-VI semiconductor with these curves is described.

articleTitle: Optical properties of integrated type amplifiers using erbium doped crystal film waveguides
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP '96 Technical Digest. Satellite Workshop (Cat. No.96TH8153)
abstract: Theoretical analysis and experimental investigation of the optical properties of integrated optical waveguide amplifiers are presented. Both steady-state and dynamic characteristics of rare earth doped crystal thin film waveguide have been analyzed. Nd/sup 3+/ ion doped crystal waveguides are used for the amplification of light signals in the 1.06 /spl mu/m band and Er/sup 3+/ doped waveguides are considered in the 1.55 /spl mu/m band. The optical properties such as loss, fluorescence and absorption spectra have been investigated which determine the gain characteristics of the amplifier. The experimental results and future directions are also presented.

articleTitle: Scattering parameters of microstrip band pass filter under laser spot illumination
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP '96 Technical Digest. Satellite Workshop (Cat. No.96TH8153)
abstract: We have demonstrated, in detail, the scattering parameters of an optically controlled microstrip band pass filter fabricated on the semiconductor substrate. Frequency dependence on the transmission characteristics S/sub 21/ are evaluated theoretically, when the plural number of laser spots illuminated both air gaps on this filter. Further, the distribution of the standing waves occurring on the filter have been measured experimentally using the optical probing technique, and the most sensitive position to be controlled optically is discussed.

articleTitle: Double optical phase-locked loop for reception of SCN signal
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP '96 Technical Digest. Satellite Workshop (Cat. No.96TH8153)
abstract: A broad band receiver for coherent SCM signals has been presented. Unlike its predecessors this receiver does not generate intermodulation noise. Numerical experiments agree well with the theoretical findings.

articleTitle: Frequency response of time-varying photocapacitance of an InP:Fe MIS capacitor
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP '96 Technical Digest. Satellite Workshop (Cat. No.96TH8153)
abstract: In this paper the effect of intensity modulated illumination on the photocapacitance of an InP metal-insulator-semiconductor (MIS) structure has been reported. A theoretical model of the device has been developed and the results obtained on the basis of the model have been presented for determining the dependence of the time-varying photocapacitance of the device on the frequency of the signal modulating the intensity of incident illumination.

articleTitle: Negative light-modulation phenomenon in Er-doped YAG crystal using a modulated laser diode
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP '96 Technical Digest. Satellite Workshop (Cat. No.96TH8153)
abstract: Dependence of the negative nonlinear absorption effect on both the sample length and the modulation frequency of the incident laser were investigated in an erbium doped yttrium aluminum garnet crystal. Negative light-modulation phenomenon was observed at 100 MHz.

articleTitle: Effect of EDFA ASE noise on the performance of millimetre-wave fibre radio communication systems
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP '96 Technical Digest. Satellite Workshop (Cat. No.96TH8153)
abstract: Effect of EDFA ASE noise on millimeter-wave fibre radio communication systems was studied. Greater effect is found for higher EDFA gain. An optical filter reduces the effect considerably. Splitting loss after EDFA degrades system performance slightly.

articleTitle: An analysis of traveling-wave optical modulator with thick, trapezoidal electrodes on multilayered dielectric substrate
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP '96 Technical Digest. Satellite Workshop (Cat. No.96TH8153)
abstract: In this paper, an analysis of traveling-wave optical modulator with thick trapezoidal cross-sectional electrodes on multilayered dielectric substrate is presented. The method of analysis uses a combination of the conformal mapping technique and the variational principle.

articleTitle: Devices for microwave photonics
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP '96 Technical Digest. Satellite Workshop (Cat. No.96TH8153)
abstract: Microwave photonics has advanced greatly as a result of breakthroughs on many fronts. Breakthroughs in fiber amplifiers, sources and receivers have all resulted in greatly increased system performance, and significant evolution of microwave photonic networks has occurred. The author discusses these elements in turn. There are many applications of microwave photonics, including fiber optic distribution of signals for cellular networks, phase array radars, and cable TV. Bandwidth requirements in these applications keep increasing, driving up the center frequency and increasing the need for microwave photonics to reduce the loss, dispersion, crosstalk and cost. This is also causing an evolution in these networks from smaller, lower frequency networks at 0.88 /spl mu/m to larger, higher frequency networks at 1.3 and 1.5 /spl mu/m.

articleTitle: Concurrent modulation and transmission of microwave signal using frequency modulation of laser diode and transmission through dispersive optical fiber
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP '96 Technical Digest. Satellite Workshop (Cat. No.96TH8153)
abstract: A new fiber-optic microwave transmission scheme which enables concurrent phase modulation and transmission is proposed. A 140 Mbps DBPSK modulation and transmission over 100 km of single mode fiber is demonstrated at 1550 nm wavelength.

articleTitle: The effect of interferometric crosstalk on optically generated microwave signals
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP '96 Technical Digest. Satellite Workshop (Cat. No.96TH8153)
abstract: We report for the first time results relating to reflections/multi-path induced interferometric noise in microwave fibre radio systems. We use a rigourous formulation based on the modified Chernoff bound providing an accurate upper bound on the BER and power penalty. Simulated results show good agreement with the analytical findings.

articleTitle: Subcarrier homodyne de-multiplexing scheme for SCM optical communication systems
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP '96 Technical Digest. Satellite Workshop (Cat. No.96TH8153)
abstract: A subcarrier de-multiplexing scheme has been proposed for SCM optical communication systems, in which a pair of light modulators excited at one of subcarrier frequencies is placed in front of the optical demodulator. One of the features of this scheme is the potential immunity from interference among channels.

articleTitle: A next generation satellite ground station application using commercial 1,300 nm fiber optic components to carry K/sub T/-band microwave signals
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP '96 Technical Digest. Satellite Workshop (Cat. No.96TH8153)
abstract: This paper describes the key considerations, analysis and test results completed during the early design phases of a 20 GHz microwave satellite downlink, with a 3.6 GHz bandwidth, utilizing commercial off-the-shelf components.

articleTitle: Generation of frequency synthesized lightwave pulses by an amplified fiber-optic loop with a high-speed phase modulator
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP '96 Technical Digest. Satellite Workshop (Cat. No.96TH8153)
abstract: Broadband absolute frequency synthesis of over 1.4 THz with a 10 GHz spacing is demonstrated for pulsed coherent lightwaves. It is based on the recirculation of a rectangular pulse around an amplified fiber-optic loop with a high-speed external phase modulator, an acousto-optic (AO) frequency shifter and a high-finesse Fabry-Perot etalon for spectral reshaping.

articleTitle: Optical pulse generation at 50-GHz repetition frequency by half-frequency modulation of mode-locked lasers integrated with electroabsorption modulators
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP '96 Technical Digest. Satellite Workshop (Cat. No.96TH8153)
abstract: This paper describes optical pulse generation at a 50-GHz repetition frequency achieved by modulation at half (25 GHz) the cavity resonance frequency using a monolithic mode-locked InGaAsP laser integrated with an electroabsorption modulator.

articleTitle: New optical frequency modulation method using wavelength conversion in DFB LD with light injection
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP '96 Technical Digest. Satellite Workshop (Cat. No.96TH8153)
abstract: New optical frequency modulation method was demonstrated using wavelength conversion in DFB laser with light injection. The FM efficiency was obtained at about 80 MHz/mA in the optical frequency modulator with suppression of AM components.

articleTitle: Comparison of subharmonic synchronous mode-locking with subharmonic hybrid mode-locking of a monolithic DBR laser operating at millimeter wave frequencies
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP '96 Technical Digest. Satellite Workshop (Cat. No.96TH8153)
abstract: A detailed comparison of subharmonic synchronous mode-locking and subharmonic hybrid mode-locking of a monolithic DBR laser is presented. While subharmonic electrical injection offers ease of implementation, subharmonic optical injection offers advantages of reduced amplitude modulation and larger locking ranges.

articleTitle: Photonic DC and microwave characteristics of AlGaAs/GaAs/InGaAs pseudomorphic MODFET
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP '96 Technical Digest. Satellite Workshop (Cat. No.96TH8153)
abstract: In this work, we report photonic microwave characteristics of AlGaAs/GaAs/InGaAs pseudomorphic MODFET controlled by /spl lambda/=0.83 /spl mu/m optical source. With photonic controlled DC and microwave characteristics, we extracted nonlinear equivalent circuit model parameters of the fabricated MODFET, and investigated the physical mechanism of microwave performance improvement in the MODFET.

articleTitle: Phaseshifterless quasi-optical beam forming network
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP '96 Technical Digest. Satellite Workshop (Cat. No.96TH8153)
abstract: Disadvantages of the coherent technique of optical beam scanning, viz., requirements of narrow linewidth lasers and variable optical delays, have been overcome through the use of a modified optical PLL and principle of phase distribution in a coupled oscillator.

articleTitle: Phase noise characterization of a harmonically mode-locked erbium doped fiber ring laser
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP '96 Technical Digest. Satellite Workshop (Cat. No.96TH8153)
abstract: We present a detailed investigation of the phase noise characteristics of a harmonically mode-locked erbium doped fiber ring laser. RMS timing jitter <1 ps has been measured for a 2 GHz optical pulse train with no active stabilization of the laser.

articleTitle: Performance of an optically controlled silicon coplanar waveguide at cryogenic temperatures
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP '96 Technical Digest. Satellite Workshop (Cat. No.96TH8153)
abstract: Optically controlled performance of a high resistivity silicon substrate asymmetric CPW (with one ground plane only) is studied experimentally and theoretically in temperature range 30-300 K at frequencies 0.05-40 GHz.

articleTitle: Output pulse waveform correction by dual modulation of three-terminal Fabry-Perot diode laser
publicationTitle: International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. MWP '96 Technical Digest. Satellite Workshop (Cat. No.96TH8153)
abstract: We report on the possibility of improvement of output pulse waveform by dual modulation of three-terminal MQW FP laser. High quality eye pattern and low intensity noise operation may be obtained by using dual modulation.

abstract: Presents the program of post deadline papers.from the conference proceedings.
